The '''High Circle of Elders''' was the ruling council of the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], on the brink of deciding whether or not to support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] or the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were overthrown by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] who was declared [[All-High Priestess]].<ref name="MSW35" /><ref name="MSW36" />
